item.title: Love the roof and old call box! 4,500 square feet in Minnesota. $324,900
item.description: I love the roof on this house! The old servant call box is pretty cool too! This high style Arts and Crafts/Tudor Revival house was built in 1912. It is located on .35 acre in Austin, Minnesota. The house features a dramatic rolled cedar shingle roof, which was designed to mimic Old World thatch. Inside there is rich original woodwork, exposed beams, leaded glass doors, built-ins and period finishes. There is a picture of the old servant call box. item.title: Diamond in the Rough! C. 1938. On 2 1/2 acres in Mississippi. $125,000
item.description: This house looks like a diamond in the rough! The price is very reasonable. The house was built in 1938. It is located on 2.5 acres in Aberdeen, Mississippi. The brick house features wood floors, picture rails, baseboards, built-in shelving, crown moulding and a nice staircase. There is a carport on the property and mature trees. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,580 square feet. $125,000 Contact Bill Strauss with Coldwell Banker Frady and Associates: 662-574-0720 From the Zillow listing: Charm

item.title: Fixer Upper Alert! Seven acres in Virginia. $125,000
item.description: Fixer upper alert! This could be a nice little getaway place with some work! The house was built in 1949. It is located on seven acres in Duffield, Virginia. The house features an enclosed front porch, spacious kitchen, vintage chandelier and baseboards. Could work room by room with this house. The house has a newer metal roof and there is a detached storage building. Four bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,264 square feet. $125,000 Contact Geri Trent with eXp Realty: 423-956-3556 From the Zillow list

item.title: Diamond in the Rough! 7 beds/4 baths. C. 1894 in Missouri. $350,000
item.description: This house looks like a diamond in the rough! And it’s a big house with seven bedrooms and four bathrooms! The house was built in 1894. It is located on .29 acre in St. Louis, Missouri. The house features original wood floors, fretwork, stained glass, baseboards, exposed brick, vintage light fixtures, pocket doors, transom windows, claw foot tubs and pretty mantels. There is a large basement and a detached carriage house. House has a new roof. Seven bedrooms, four bathrooms and 3,306 square feet

item.title: Governor Erickson Cabin. Circa 1938 in Montana. $475,000
item.description: Known as the Governor Erickson Cabin. It was built as the Governor’s getaway spot. The cabin was built in the late 1930’s. It is located on .56 acre in Polson, Montana. The cabin features a stone chimney, wood floors, great picture windows, crown moulding, beautiful fireplace, wainscoting and french doors. There is a large patio and detached garage. The property is situated a couple of miles from Yellow Bay State Park. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1m624 square feet. $475,000 Contact Nancy O

item.title: Former Carnegie Library! Circa 1911 in Nebraska. $395,000
item.description: It would be neat owning a former Carnegie Library! It was built in 1911. The former library is located Neligh, Nebraska. The house features original wood flooring, baseboards, double doors, tall ceilings, arched entryways, built-ins, picture rails, spacious kitchen and updated bathrooms. There is a fenced in area in the backyard and a detached garage. Four bedrooms, three bathrooms and 1,625 square feet. $395,000 Contact Keith White with White Realty and Appraisal: 402-929-0041 From the Zillow l

item.title: Circa 1795! Wide floor boards! Over an acre in New Hampshire. $300,000
item.description: Those are some wide floor boards! The house was built in 1795. It is located on 1.4 acres in Alton, New Hampshire. The house features a sunroom, large fireplace, wide plank floors, exposed beams, wide baseboards, wainscoting and a sauna. There are multiple outbuildings and a pond on the property. Five bedrooms, four bathrooms and 3,967 square feet. $300,000 Contact Tracy L. Hayes with Century 21: 603-332-9500 From the Zillow listing: Attention INVESTORS!! item.title: Rube Oldring House, Legendary Outfielder. C. 1890 in New Jersey. $285,000
item.description: Love the setting for this house! This was once owned by Ruben Henry (Rube) Oldring. He was a legendary outfielder for the Philadelphia Athletics. he played a pivotal role in the team’s victories in the 1911 and 1913 World Series. The house was built in 1890. It is located on .37 acre in Bridgeton, New Jersey. The house features a covered front porch, covered side porch, some wood floors, baseboards, spacious kitchen, exposed beams and a basement. item.title: The details! 9 beds/6 baths! Circa 1906 in Ohio. $235,000
item.description: This house has some amazing details! Love the fireplace with inglenook seating! The house was built in 1906. It is located on .34 acre in Toledo, Ohio. The house features a large covered front porch, wood floors, pretty staircase, crown moulding, wide baseboards, stained glass windows, exposed beams, fireplace with inglenook seating, crown moulding, picture rails and vintage bathrooms.
